name: RMN Soup
summary:
A Soup-like is a game inspired by the Japanese art game SOUP.

RMN Soup is a collaborative soup-like created using the Bapalon engine by users of rpgmaker.net. It is a pure exploration simulator where you go through a series of rooms and enjoy the scenery. Some are funny, some are unnerving, and some are cozy. You never know what you're going to get next!

RMN Soup currently contains 28 rooms by a total of 9 contributors.
